note: Triennial election of the county council, 1908: polled 27 May 1908 in twelve divisions; the other nine (ten seats) returned unopposed, Killeavy by the sitting member being deemed re-elected for want of a nomination. Returned unopposed. "Has been returned unopposed"; printed "T. S. Hardy" (Thomas H. Hardy stood for Richhill in 1902). Described in the nominations as: T. S. Hardy, J.P. (anti-direct labour). T. H. Hardy: no party label printed in 1908. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Richhill, Armagh Rural District, 25 May 1905, printed 'Unionist': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Guardians' Nominations"; "All the candidates are Unionists save where marked N."); withdrawals from the Armagh Guardian, 5 May 1905, p. 4 ("Poor Law Guardians": contests and withdrawals)).
